speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity (born <32 weeks).

The history of prematurity and C-section delivery puts this baby at high risk for lung immaturity. I will need to review the chest X-ray and blood gas results to confirm the diagnosis and assess severity. Please provide the Chest_X-Ray and Arterial_Blood_Gas results.
